questions.q: A fair die is rolled twice. What is the probability of exactly one six? Give your answer as a decimal rounded to 4 decimal places. Variant 1.
questions.explanation: Exactly one six has 10 ordered outcomes out of 36, so 10/36 = 0.277777..., rounded to 0.2778.
